nodes.name: Webhook - Campaign Trigger
Fetch Campaign Details
nodes.notes:
Reads campaign from Campaigns tab (Columns A-N)
Lookup by Campaign_ID (Column A)

nodes.name: Check Campaign Status = Draft
nodes.notes: Only proceed if Campaign Status (Column G) = 'Draft'

nodes.name: Fetch All Customers
nodes.notes: Reads all customers from Customer Profiles tab (Columns A-V)

nodes.name: Filter Opted-In Customers
nodes.notes:
Filters customers:
1. Column V (Opt_Out_Promotional) = FALSE
2. Apply Target_Audience filter (Column F)
   - All: Send to everyone
   - VIP: Column M = VIP
   - Recent Buyers: Column J within 30 days

nodes.name: Loop Over Customers
nodes.notes: Process one customer at a time

nodes.name: Prepare Personalized Message
Wait 2 Seconds (Rate Limiting)
nodes.notes:
WhatsApp rate limiting:
- Max 15 msg/sec (safe: 10/sec)
- 2 sec delay = ~0.5 msg/sec

nodes.name: Log to Campaign_Delivery
nodes.notes:
Appends to Campaign_Delivery tab (Columns A-F):
- Campaign_ID (A)
- Customer_Phone (B)
- Customer_Name (C)
- Status (D) = 'Sent'
- Sent_At (E)
- Error_Message (F) = empty

nodes.name: All Customers Processed?
nodes.notes: Check if all customers have been processed

nodes.name: Calculate Campaign Statistics
nodes.notes:
Counts:
- Total Recipients (Column I)
- Messages Sent (Column J)
- Messages Failed (Column K)

nodes.name: Update Campaign Statistics
nodes.notes:
Updates Campaigns tab:
- Total_Recipients (Column I)
- Messages_Sent (Column J)
- Messages_Failed (Column K)
- Status (Column G) = 'Sent'

nodes.name: Respond - Success
nodes.notes: Returns success response with statistics

nodes.name: Respond - Wrong Status
nodes.notes: Returns error if campaign status is not 'Draft'

nodes.name: Send WhatsApp Template Message
nodes.notes:
Sends via WAHA API:
- Image from Windows path
- Message with personalization
- Opt-out footer included
